[[File:Solidification icon.png|right]]
'''Solidification''' is an [[Arts Reaction]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

==Overview==
[[Solidification]] is a debuff applied by Operators and Enemies. Solidification lasts for a duration and prevents the unit from taking action.
===Friendly===
Some [[Operators]] are capable of applying [[Solidification]].
* The debuff lasts for {{Color|5.75 – 8.75s (based on the Status Level)|1d}}.
* When an operator applies {{G|Cryo Infliction}} to an enemy with a ([[File:Heat Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Electric Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]/[[File:Nature Infliction icon.png|16x16px|link=]]) Non-Cryo Infliction, the Arts Infliction that was applied first is {{G|Debuff Consumption|consumed}} to trigger [[Solidification]].
** Deals an initial instance of {{Color|160% – 400% of ATK (based on the Status Level)|1d}} as {{Tip|Base|Unofficial term: Before being increased or decreased by other effects}} Cryo DMG.
** Applying {{G|Vulnerable}} or a {{G|Physical Status}} {{G|Debuff Consumption|consumes}} the debuff to trigger {{G|Shatter}} and deal {{Color|240% – 600% of ATK (based on the Status Level)|1d}} as {{Tip|Base|Unofficial term: Before being increased or decreased by other effects}} Physical DMG. This is considered as Shatter DMG.

</table>

* Some operator skills can also {{Tooltip/Forcibly apply|Arts|forcibly apply}} Solidification without requiring a different Arts Infliction to be {{G|Debuff Consumption|consumed}}.
** Forced Solidification does not consume any Arts Inflictions (if any) and applies the reaction as {{G|Status Level|Status Level I}} (unless otherwise specified).
** Forced Solidification does not trigger the initial instance of Cryo DMG caused by applying multiple Arts Inflictions of different elements.

===Hostile===
{{Quote|Certain enemy skills can apply stacks of Cryo Infliction to operators. At 4 stacks, the operator becomes Solidified: Cannot move for a certain duration.|Tutorial}}

Some [[Enemies]] are capable of applying '''Solidification'''.
* When an Operator reaches 4 stacks of Cryo Infliction, all existing Cryo Infliction stacks are removed to trigger Solidification.
** Prevents the Operator from taking action over the debuff duration. This includes any movement or skill actions. If the controlled Operator is solidifed, the player will be also unable to switch Operators.
* The debuff lasts {{Color|3.5s|1d}} (unless otherwise specified). {{Needs Verification}}.
* While under the effects of '''Solidification''', the debuffed operator cannot be inflicted by further [[Cryo Infliction|Cryo Inflictions]].

== Calculations ==
<tabber>
|-|Initial Cryo DMG=
{{Main|Damage calculation}}
* The following effects stack <u>multiplicatively</u> with each other and with the Base Initial Cryo DMG:
** Each operator level increases the Base Initial Cryo DMG by {{Tip|{{Color|~0.51%|1d}}|0.510204081%}}.
*** <math>{Level\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{195 + Operator\,Level}{196}</math><br>
** Each point of [[Arts Intensity]] increases the Base Initial Cryo DMG by {{Color|1%|1d}}.
*** <math>{Arts\,Intensity\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{100 + Arts\,Intensity}{100}</math><br>
** If the damage critically strikes, increases the Base Initial Cryo DMG by some amount equal to the [[Critical DMG]].
*** <math>
{Critical\,Multiplier} =
\begin{cases} 
1 + {Critical\,DMG},  & \mbox{if the hit is critical}\\
1, & \mbox{if the hit is not critical} 
\end{cases}
</math>
** If the enemy is {{Color|Staggered|8}}, increases the Base Initial Cryo DMG by {{Color|30%|1d}}.
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Cryo DMG to form the <b>Multiplier Group</b>:
** <math>{Multiplier\,Group} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** Arts DMG Bonus
** Cryo DMG Bonus
** If the enemy is {{Color|Staggered|8}}, DMG Bonus vs. Staggered
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Cryo DMG to form the <b>Amp Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Amp\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** {{G|Arts Amp}}
** {{G|Cryo Amp}}
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Cryo DMG to form the <b>Susceptibility Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Susceptibility\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** {{G|Arts Susceptibility}}
** {{G|Cryo Susceptibility}}
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Cryo DMG to form the <b>Increased DMG Taken Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Increased\,DMG\,Taken\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** If the enemy is affected by Arts DMG Taken effects
** If the enemy is affected by Cryo DMG Taken effects
** If the enemy is affected by {{G|Electrification}}, increases the sum multiplier by {{Color|12 – 24% (based on the Status Level)|1d}} at Base Strength
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Initial Cryo DMG to form the <b>Resistance Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Resistance\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** The enemy's Innate Cryo Resistance decreases the sum multiplier
** If the enemy is affected by {{G|Corrosion}}, increases the sum multiplier by {{Color|3.6% – 24% (based on the Status Level and Total Duration Elapsed)|1d}}

|-|Shatter DMG=
{{Main|Damage calculation}}
The following effects stack <u>multiplicatively</u> with the  Shatter DMG:
* Each operator level increases the Shatter DMG by {{Tip|{{Color|~0.51%|1d}}|0.510204081%}}.
** <math>{Level\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{195 + Operator\,Level}{196}</math><br>
* Each point of [[Arts Intensity]] increases the Shatter DMG by {{Color|1%|1d}}.
** <math>{Arts\,Intensity\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{100 + Arts\,Intensity}{100}</math>
** If the damage critically strikes, increases the Shatter DMG by some amount equal to the [[Critical DMG]].
*** <math>
{Critical\,Multiplier} =
\begin{cases} 
1 + {Critical\,DMG},  & \mbox{if the hit is critical}\\
1, & \mbox{if the hit is not critical} 
\end{cases}
</math>
** If the enemy is {{Color|Staggered|8}}, increases the Shatter DMG by {{Color|30%|1d}}.
** If the enemy is affected by {{G|Physical Susceptibility}}, increases the Shatter DMG by some amount equal to the strength of the debuff.
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Shatter DMG to form the <b>Multiplier Group</b>:
** <math>{Multiplier\,Group} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** Physical DMG Bonus
** If the enemy is {{Color|Staggered|8}}, DMG Bonus vs. Staggered
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Shatter DMG to form the <b>Increased DMG Taken Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Increased\,DMG\,Taken\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** If the enemy is affected by Physical DMG Taken effects
** If the enemy is affected by {{G|Breach}}, increases the sum multiplier by {{Color|12 – 24% (based on the Status Level)|1d}} at Base Strength
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Shatter DMG to form the <b>Resistance Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Resistance\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** The enemy's Innate Physical Resistance decreases the sum multiplier
** If the enemy is affected by {{G|Corrosion}}, increases the sum multiplier by {{Color|3.6% – 24% (based on the Status Level and Total Duration Elapsed)|1d}}
</tabber>
